title: macrosolen avenis
intro: Macrosolen avenis, commonly known as the Indian Oak Apple or Indian Mistletoe, is a parasitic plant species native to the Western Ghats region of India. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Macrosolen avenis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
